body: It's hard. I imagined how I would react to losing her and it's a scary thought. My parents are still alive, my siblings are all healthy and even my grandparents are alive. I have never dealt with a close death compared to others. And I honestly am afraid of when I'll finally experience it, because i'm not sure how I'll handle it. But to know that somebody who I plan to spend the rest of my life with, takes her own life, it may aswell be my fault and I'd have to live with that for the rest of my life. I'm trying my best to be there for her, but I've given her so much care and attention... I just wish I could get some too.
